claim_boundary: This is an apples-to-apples fusion comparison on a shared 3DSSG target. It tests score construction under fixed routing, not dataset-level generalization or universal formula superiority.

methods.routed_matched_mlp: the same route with the frozen train-only supervision-matched nonlinear compatibility model
methods.routed_product: family-slot routing with the projected compatibility product
methods.routed_rank_average: the same route with within-context source/compatibility percentile averaging
methods.routed_rrf: the same route with reciprocal-rank fusion (c=60)
